threads.body: The extra parentheses/multiline wrapper around the provider name value don’t seem necessary and are inconsistent with nearby one-liners in the same dict. Consider making this a single line assignment for readability.

threads.body: Since this PR changes behavior from emitting deprecated `gen_ai.system` to `gen_ai.provider.name`, it would be helpful to assert the deprecated attribute is *not* present on the span (e.g., `GenAIAttributes.GEN_AI_SYSTEM not in span.attributes`). This prevents regressions where both attributes accidentally get emitted (or the deprecated one slips back in).
